base.sizeSource: SG.variants.cellCountOf(def): the registry's static size; the built-model count is the quick test variants-registry MS05r5p-T01, not run here

source.recipe: engine.sources = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over the bytes of the files of SOURCE_FILES in generator/tests/node-runner.js (js/ui and js/worker skipped, missing files skipped), in that order, no separator (tests/qualify.js sourceFiles + sourcesHash)

tool.recipe: qualifierHash = SHA-256 over generator/tests/qualify.js bytes, NUL, generator/tests/fixtures/qualification-records.js bytes, NUL (tests/qualify.js qualifierHash)

attemptPolicy.recipe: the object { function: "SG.digger.defaultMaxAttempts", explicitMaxAttempts: false, sources: { file: SHA-256 of its bytes } } of tests/qualify.js attemptPolicy for POLICY_FILES; digest = SHA-256 of its canonical text (sorted keys, as the records helper canon): the digest is this task's own, the qualifier compares the object

node.recipe: process.version of the Node that runs this planner (the Node the locked runner starts is the first `node` on PATH; the qualifier workers use process.execPath)

machine.recipe: the object of tests/qualify.js machineInfo(4): { cpu, logicalProcessors, memoryGb, platform, node, jobs }; digest = SHA-256 of its canonical text
